title: 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE
text: The substate 5GMM-REGISTERED.NORMAL-SERVICE is chosen by the UE as the primary substate when the UE enters the state 5GMM-REGISTERED, and
- for 3GPP access, the cell the UE selected is known to be in an allowed area (see subclause5.3.5.2); or
- for wireline access, the wireline access service area restrictions are not enforced
